step_by_step_approach: Select all legislators who are female.
Record the state each of these legislators first represented.
Check each legislator's term dates to see if any term covered December 31st.
Keep only those female legislators whose terms included December 31st.
Link each remaining legislator to their first‑represented state.
Count how many qualifying legislators belong to each state.
Identify the state with the highest count.
Return that state's abbreviation together with the count.
